items.text: Scaffold bridges/did workspace (Cargo.toml resolver=2 Apache-2.0, did-types / did-bridge / did-tests) mirroring the valueflows bridge pattern
did-types: DID 1.1 data model (DidDocument, VerificationMethod Multikey ed25519, five verification relationships, Service, alsoKnownAs, controller) — serde camelCase wire-faithful, no I/O
DidResolver trait + DidResolutionResult with standard DID 1.1 resolution/document metadata error semantics (notFound, invalidDid, methodNotSupported)
did:key codec — AgentPubKey (39-byte holo hash) <-> did:key z-base58btc(0xed01+core32) round-trip, property-tested, loc bytes recomputed on reverse; fixture from real fleet agent keys

did:elohim method — self-certifying (id IS agent_cid), resolution assembles projection via an assembly contract (verification method from agent key, humans-projection profile service, doorway service entries, transport ids as alsoKnownAs); mock-store contract test
did:web resolver impl, feature-gated (fetch); needed as atproto foundation
elohim-storage implements the did:elohim assembly contract (owns the joins: agent key, humans projection, doorway registrations, transport ids)

Doorway routes: GET /1.0/identifiers/{did} (universal-resolver-compatible) + GET /.well-known/did.json (doorway's own did:web) — match arm + is_service_path + unit test. Separate leg after crate green. @requires:household-nodes
Phase-1 DoD: bridges/did cargo build + nextest + clippy -D warnings + fmt --check green (RUSTFLAGS empty, pooled target dir)
Phase-2 identity head + agent-key lineage (controllers = self + community-recovery quorum, rotation-as-update, lineage DAG) — MUST route full p2p-design-gate before design; deferred follow-on
